import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    ledger = inputs["ledger"].copy()

    # Sort exactly as the cursor ORDER BY account_id, entry_date, row_seq
    ledger = ledger.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "entry_date", "row_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to keep deterministic tie-breaking
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Determine cycle number: starts at 1 for each account, increments by 1
    # on every STMT row (the increment applies to that same row, since the
    # reset happens BEFORE the amount is added).
    is_stmt = (ledger["entry_type"] == "STMT").astype(int)
    cyc = 1 + is_stmt.groupby(ledger["account_id"]).cumsum()

    # Balance: cumulative sum of amount (NULL treated as 0) within each
    # (account_id, cyc) segment, because the reset-to-zero coincides exactly
    # with the start of a new cycle number.
    amount_filled = ledger["amount"].fillna(0)

    cycle_balance = amount_filled.groupby(
        [ledger["account_id"], cyc]
    ).cumsum()

    result = ledger.copy()
    result["cycle_no"] = cyc
    result["cycle_balance"] = cycle_balance

    out = result[
        ["account_id", "row_seq", "entry_date", "entry_type", "amount",
         "cycle_no", "cycle_balance"]
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"cycle_balances": out}
